name: Heartlight Lantern
description: An elven lantern housing cultivated Hearthlight Fungus in a shaped crystal-and-wood frame — the standard Thornveil and Vaelmere evening light source, available in limited realm trade.
narrative_effects: Provides soft continuous bioluminescent light without fuel, flame, or smoke.
The fungus responds to ambient-field conditions: brightness subtly dims under Turning, cooperating with the Feywood's health register rather than masking it.
Lantern housing lasts indefinitely; the fungal colony requires periodic refreshment at Thornveil or from a trained elven keeper.
